meta.subject: fix rd_rsp_rdy control logic bug in wt

en.summary: Fixes weight-path response credit accounting in CDMA so simultaneous buffer-write and scorecard-update events use the correct configured delta instead of a hard-coded single-entry increment.
why_it_counts: The patch modifies only DUT RTL in a central weight DMA module.
The changed counter controls whether DMA read responses are accepted, so the fix alters real hardware flow control.
The old branch used a fixed `+1 - sc_wt_entries` update even when one external beat represented more or fewer internal atomic transfers.
evidence: The commit message explicitly calls out an `rd_rsp_rdy` control-logic bug in the weight path.
The simultaneous `wt_cbuf_wr_vld_w & sc_wt_updt` case is expanded into configuration-dependent branches instead of always using a single-entry increment.
Nearby code derives `dma_rd_rsp_rdy` from `wt_wr_dmatx_cnt`, tying the counter directly to response acceptance.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A buffered DMA or cache-fill path often tracks outstanding stored data with a credit or occupancy counter. When a store-into-buffer event and a consumer/status-release event happen in the same cycle, both deltas must be applied in the same accounting unit. If the implementation hard-codes the producer delta as one entry regardless of interface-width conversion, the counter becomes wrong under configurations where one external beat maps to multiple or fractional internal atomic units.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: response credit accounting under simultaneous producer and consumer updates
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A cycle where a response beat is written into the local buffer at the same time that status logic releases previously consumed weight entries, especially when external DMA width and internal atomic width differ.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Collapse the simultaneous update case to a fixed single-beat increment minus the consumer release count, ignoring the configured beat-to-atomic scaling.
portability_notes: Apply this to the counter that gates response-ready or buffer-full logic, not to a purely diagnostic counter.
The fault is most visible when one input beat produces multiple internal entries or when several beats are needed for one internal atomic update.
Keep the pure producer-only and pure consumer-only cases intact so the bug remains localized to the simultaneous update path.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the occupancy or credit counter that is incremented by incoming data writes and decremented by downstream status release events.
Find the branch that handles both events occurring in the same cycle.
Replace its configuration-dependent delta with a fixed `+1 - released_entries` style update, regardless of the actual beat-to-entry conversion ratio.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix restores generated width-dependent logic in the `wt_cbuf_wr_vld_w & sc_wt_updt` branch so the counter adds the correct number of internal entries before subtracting `sc_wt_entries`.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Replace the generated simultaneous-update branch around `wt_wr_dmatx_cnt` with the old single-line `wt_wr_dmatx_cnt <= wt_wr_dmatx_cnt + 1'b1 - sc_wt_entries;` behavior.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Response-ready deasserts too early or stays asserted too long, causing weight-response stalls, over-acceptance, or incorrect full/empty decisions in configurations with width conversion.
evidence_for_injection: The only logic change is in the simultaneous write-plus-update branch of `wt_wr_dmatx_cnt`.
The branch is parameterized by DMA interface width versus atomic size, showing the original bug was unit-mismatch in counter updates.
The same file uses `wt_wr_dmatx_cnt` to derive `dma_rd_rsp_rdy`, so reinjecting the old delta directly recreates a real backpressure bug.
notes: This is a localized credit-accounting fault; unrelated scoreboarding or data formatting logic does not need to be changed.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 CDMA 权重路径中的响应 credit 计数，使缓冲区写入与状态释放同周期发生时使用正确的配置化增量，而不是写死的单项递增。
why_it_counts: 补丁只修改了权重 DMA 核心模块中的 DUT RTL。
被修改计数器决定 DMA 读响应是否可接收，因此该修复改变了真实硬件流控行为。
旧分支始终使用固定的 `+1 - sc_wt_entries`，即使一个外部 beat 实际对应多个或不足一个内部原子传输。
evidence: 提交信息明确指出这是权重路径中的 `rd_rsp_rdy` 控制逻辑缺陷。
`wt_cbuf_wr_vld_w & sc_wt_updt` 同时成立时的分支被展开成按配置选择的多个路径，而不再始终使用单项增量。
附近代码表明 `dma_rd_rsp_rdy` 由 `wt_wr_dmatx_cnt` 推导，因此该计数器直接决定响应接收。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 带缓冲的 DMA 或 cache fill 路径通常会用 credit 或占用计数器跟踪已写入本地缓冲的数据量。当“写入缓冲区”和“下游状态释放”在同一周期发生时，两个增减量必须以同一计量单位同时应用。如果实现把生产者增量固定写成 1，而忽略接口宽度转换，那么在一个外部 beat 对应多个或不足一个内部原子单元的配置下，计数就会出错。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 生产者与消费者同周期更新时的响应 credit 计数
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个周期内，响应 beat 被写入本地缓冲区，同时状态逻辑释放先前消费的权重项；在外部 DMA 宽度与内部原子宽度不一致时最容易暴露。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把同周期更新分支简化为固定的单 beat 增量再减去释放数量，而忽略真实的 beat 到内部项转换比例。
portability_notes: 应在控制 response-ready 或 buffer-full 的真实占用计数器上实施该故障，而不是诊断计数器。
当一个输入 beat 会产生多个内部项，或多个 beat 才组成一个内部原子更新时，该故障最明显。
保持“只有生产者”和“只有消费者”两个分支不变，使故障局限于同周期更新路径。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位由输入数据写入递增、由下游状态释放递减的占用或 credit 计数器。
找到处理这两个事件同周期发生的分支。
把该分支改成固定的 `+1 - released_entries` 式更新，而不管真实的 beat 与内部项换算关系。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 驱动 `dma_rd_rsp_rdy` 的 CDMA 权重路径 `wt_wr_dmatx_cnt` 更新逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 `wt_cbuf_wr_vld_w & sc_wt_updt` 分支中恢复了按位宽配置生成的逻辑，使计数器先增加正确的内部项数，再减去 `sc_wt_entries`。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 `wt_wr_dmatx_cnt` 附近的同周期更新分支改回旧的单行行为 `wt_wr_dmatx_cnt <= wt_wr_dmatx_cnt + 1'b1 - sc_wt_entries;`。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在存在位宽转换的配置下，response-ready 会过早拉低或错误保持拉高，导致权重响应停顿、过量接收，或缓冲区满空判断错误。
evidence_for_injection: 唯一逻辑修改点就是 `wt_wr_dmatx_cnt` 的同周期写入加释放分支。
该分支按 DMA 接口宽度与原子大小参数化，说明原始问题确实是计数单位不匹配。
同一文件用 `wt_wr_dmatx_cnt` 推导 `dma_rd_rsp_rdy`，因此恢复旧增量可以直接重建真实回压故障。
notes: 这是一个局部 credit 计数故障，不需要修改无关的 scoreboarding 或数据格式化逻辑。
